mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, house_id, batch_id, mother_rabbit_id, male_rabbit_id, cycle_no, stage, stage_entered_at, lifecycle, result, mating_method, state_version, mating_date, pregnancy_check_date, pregnancy_result, expected_birth_date, birth_date, weaning_date, closed_at, close_reason, request_id, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, total_kits, live_kits, current_nursing_kits, weaned_kits, avg_weaning_weight
mapper.insert:
insert into breeding_cycles ( tenant_id, house_id, batch_id, mother_rabbit_id, male_rabbit_id, cycle_no, stage, stage_entered_at, lifecycle, result, mating_method, state_version, mating_date, pregnancy_check_date, pregnancy_result, expected_birth_date, birth_date, weaning_date, request_id, remark, total_kits, live_kits, current_nursing_kits, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{batchId}, #{motherRabbitId}, #{maleRabbitId}, #{cycleNo}, #{stage}, #{stageEnteredAt}, #{lifecycle}, #{result}, #{matingMethod}, 0, #{matingDate}, #{pregnancyCheckDate}, #{pregnancyResult}, #{expectedBirthDate}, #{birthDate}, #{weaningDate}, #{requestId}, #{remark},
coalesce(#{totalKits}, 0), coalesce(#{liveKits}, 0), coalesce(#{currentNursingKits}, 0), #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select from breeding_cycles where house_id = #{houseId} and mother_rabbit_id = #{motherRabbitId} and lifecycle = 'OPEN' and stage in ('AWAIT_ESTRUS', 'AWAIT_MATING', 'AWAIT_PALPATION', 'AWAIT_PREPARTUM', 'AWAIT_DELIVERY') order by id desc limit 1 for update
